editorial_thesis: The day’s leverage is operational evidence: make protocol state explicit, verify where requests run, and make agent memory and research support inspectable before action.

topic_groups.title: Stateless MCP Migration
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary releases or research in a coverage gap; selected for a bounded, inspectable operational experiment.

sources.title: MCP 2026-07-28 release candidate
sources.why_selected: The protocol revision changes how remote tool servers scale, route, cache, and request user input.
sources.usefulness: Audit Buildn MCP servers for hidden session dependence; model durable state as explicit IDs.

sources.title: Cloudflare Agents SDK v0.20.0
sources.why_selected: It turns the protocol change into a deployable migration pattern: factory handler, fallback, and parallel legacy support.
sources.usefulness: Use the handler pattern as a reference for Workers-hosted client tools.

topic_groups.title: Residency + Real-time Agent Transport
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary releases or research in a coverage gap; selected for a bounded, inspectable operational experiment.

sources.title: Regional inference on AI Gateway
sources.why_selected: It converts an informal residency promise into a request-level control that can be logged and checked.
sources.usefulness: Build a region assertion into client workflows handling residency-sensitive briefs.

sources.title: WebSocket mode for OpenAI Responses API
sources.why_selected: Long tool-call rollouts can reduce repeated context transfer and improve interactive latency.
sources.usefulness: Benchmark a supervised, multi-tool client workflow against current HTTP behavior.

topic_groups.title: Evidence-first Agent Memory
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary releases or research in a coverage gap; selected for a bounded, inspectable operational experiment.

sources.title: MemChain: interpretable memory traces
sources.why_selected: It makes the intermediate evidence context inspectable rather than treating raw retrieval as ready-to-use truth.
sources.usefulness: Adopt the artifact pattern: plan, selected evidence, conflicts, and final answer.

sources.title: EviBack: evidence-constrained teacher backoff
sources.why_selected: The separation guards against a polished answer being mistaken for an adequately supported one.
sources.usefulness: Use an evidence-sufficiency gate before drafting client-facing research claims.
